correctness.rationale: The deck separates by substring length and determines the total Parikh vector T and unordered inward prefix/suffix path vertices {L_i,R_i}. Complement identities L_(n-i)=T-R_i, R_(n-i)=T-L_i reconstruct outer layers; at odd n the central symbol T-L_m-R_m is forced and must be one unit vector. When successive layer vertices A!=B and C!=D, both perfect matchings cannot simultaneously use only unit-coordinate increments, because they would force two distinct target vertices to agree. Thus orientation is unique across each non-meeting interval, with independent exchanges only at levels of equal vertices. For n<=5 there is at most one nontrivial separated excursion, hence one reversal orbit; for n=6 a second separated excursion requires L1!=R1, L2=R2, L3!=R3, exactly the displayed four words. The length-one deck and length-three difference from the common length-two vector recover the unordered outer pair and unordered center pair, ensuring distinct fiber indexing. Palindromes give q^3 unique singleton decks; others not in quadruples pair under reversal, yielding the exact formula. Independent DIRECT enumeration of full multiset decks for q=2,3,4,5 gives lengths-six totals 35,369,2044,7775 and the exact (1,2,4)-fiber counts for all four sizes. The finite tests support, but do not prove, the universal q statement.

final_claim: For every labelled alphabet of size q>=2, the exact Parikh multiset of all nonempty prefixes and suffixes reconstructs words of lengths 1..5 up to reversal; at length 6 every fiber has size 1,2 or 4. The four-word fibers are {abcdab,abdcab,bacdba,badcba}, a!=b and c!=d, uniquely indexed by an ordered pair of unordered 2-symbol sets. At length 6 the singleton, doubleton, quadruple fiber counts are q^3, (q^6-q^3-4*C(q,2)^2)/2, C(q,2)^2; hence max error-free code size N_q(6)=(q^6+q^3)/2-C(q,2)^2.
limitations: Only exact, error-free labelled-coordinate Parikh observation for lengths<=6, not noisy masses, all-substring spectrum, or longer-length reconstruction.
Finite direct enumerations through q=5 are independent supporting checks, not a proof for every q.
